name: kpp
description: The kpp language: colouring, and IntelliSense from the kpp compiler's language server (kpp --lsp).

semanticTokenTypes.description: A word only kpp has, where it is one: check, require, fail, requireThrows, checkThrows, fallthrough, implicit, This, when, test, suite, depends...

kpp.path.markdownDescription: The kpp compiler that serves IntelliSense (`kpp.exe`). Empty: `kpp` on the PATH, as the installer puts it.

kpp.configuration.markdownDescription: The build.kpp configuration the language server checks the code in (`debug`, `release`, or another of build.kpp's). *kpp: Select the Target and Configuration* in the status bar sets it.

kpp.target.markdownDescription: The build.kpp target (executable) the language server checks the code in. Null: every target's sources together. *kpp: Select the Target and Configuration* in the status bar sets it.

kpp.executable.description: The old name of kpp.target, still read when kpp.target is null.

kpp.settings.markdownDescription: Settings for build.kpp, as `kpp --set NAME=VALUE` gives them.

kpp.inactiveCodeOpacity.markdownDescription: How opaque the code the selected target and configuration do not build is drawn: an `if constexpr` branch not taken, a false `when` declaration. 1: as the rest.

kpp.trace.server.description: Log the messages between VS Code and the language server in the kpp output.
